edition.tagline: Five strangers. One detention. Plenty of snacks.
edition.cue: Serve the snacks when everyone unpacks their lunch.

s.note: Ham and cheese sandwiches, potato chips, apples and cold milk.
s.how: Make three ham and cheese sandwiches using 6 slices white bread, 120g leg ham and 90g cheddar. Cut each sandwich into four small pieces. Put three pieces in each of four paper bags, along with 20g potato chips and one quarter of each of 2 sliced apples. Serve 100ml cold full cream milk per person in small cartons or glasses.

s.note: Crackers, cheese and salami for anyone who forgot their lunch.
s.how: Arrange 80g crackers, 100g cubed cheddar and 80g sliced salami on a shared plate in the middle of the table. Let everyone help themselves.

m.note: Roasted tomato soup with cream, plus crustless peanut butter and jam sandwiches.
m.how: Halve 800g tomatoes and put in a roasting dish with 1 quartered brown onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp olive oil. Roast at 200°C conventional for 35 minutes until softened and browned. Transfer to a pot with 500ml chicken stock and simmer 10 minutes. Blitz smooth with 80ml thickened cream and season with salt and pepper. Pour into four warmed thermoses. Make four peanut butter and jam sandwiches with 8 slices white bread, 80g peanut butter and 60g jam; cut off the crusts and serve with the soup.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies with a soft centre and crisp edges.
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100g butter gently and cool slightly. Whisk in 120g caster sugar and 2 eggs. Fold in 60g plain flour and a pinch of salt. Pour into a lined 18cm square tin and bake at 175°C conventional for 25 minutes until the edges are set and the middle still gently wobbles. Cool at least 30 minutes before cutting into four portions.

d.note: Cold full cream milk, plain or mixed with cocoa and sugar.
d.how: Serve 200ml cold full cream milk per person in four small cartons or glasses. For chocolate milk, dissolve 20g cocoa and 25g caster sugar in 100ml hot milk, cool, then mix with 700ml cold milk and divide among four glasses. Use the same total 800ml milk for either version.
